units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 16:11">Targ. Prov. XVI, 11</cite>.

Bekh. 11ᵃ עין יפה … בינונית בר׳ the liberal (redeems the first born ass) with a Sela, the stingy with a Shekel (two Zuz), he of a middle disposition, with a ‘middle’; ib. הלכתא בר׳ … רגיל הכא ורגיל הכא the law requires a rigia, and how much is this? Three Zuz, running this way and running that way.
